description: Selects specified fields or character positions from each input line.
impact: Reads input and prints selected portions, which may contain secrets.
riskReason: Output can disclose sensitive data; redirection may write results to a file.

description: Transforms or removes selected characters in input text.
impact: Reads input and writes transformed output.
riskReason: Normally a filter; output redirection can modify files.

description: Reads and transforms JSON data using a filter expression.
impact: May display private JSON values or write transformed output.
riskReason: Filter expressions and output redirection determine what data is exposed or changed.

description: Processes text records using a supplied pattern and action program.
impact: Can print, transform, or write data depending on the program.
riskReason: The supplied program may execute actions beyond simple text display.

description: Processes text with editing commands and writes the result to output.
impact: In-place options can modify files; ordinary output may reveal sensitive content.
riskReason: Review editing and in-place options before allowing changes.

description: Calculates or checks SHA-256 digests for files or input.
impact: Reads selected data and prints or checks its digest.
riskReason: Normally read-only; file paths and digest output may still be sensitive.

description: Calculates or checks MD5 digests for files or input; MD5 is not suitable for modern security guarantees.
impact: Reads selected data and prints or checks its digest.
riskReason: Normally read-only; do not treat MD5 as proof of authenticity.

description: Calculates or checks SHA-family digests for files or input.
impact: Reads selected data and prints or checks its digest.
riskReason: Normally read-only; verify the selected algorithm and trusted reference.

description: Displays input bytes in octal, hexadecimal, or another representation.
impact: Reads files and may reveal their contents in a different format.
riskReason: Output can expose sensitive data even when it is not readable as ordinary text.

description: Displays file or input bytes as hexadecimal and other formatted values.
impact: Reads data and may reveal content or metadata.
riskReason: Binary output may still expose sensitive information.

description: Extracts readable text sequences from binary files or other input.
impact: May reveal embedded credentials, paths, or other private strings.
riskReason: Binary files can contain secrets not visible in normal file viewing.

description: Sets or exports environment variables for the current shell and its child processes.
impact: Changes configuration inherited by later programs and may expose values to them.
riskReason: Variables may contain secrets or alter the behavior of later commands.

description: Enables stricter checking of PowerShell scripts in the current scope.
impact: Changes how later script expressions are evaluated.
riskReason: Normally a script setting; its effects depend on the surrounding script.

description: Evaluates a condition such as file attributes or string comparisons in a shell.
impact: Normally returns a status used by conditional logic.
riskReason: The condition itself is usually read-only; inspect commands in the surrounding script.

description: Evaluates a shell test expression and returns a status for conditional logic.
impact: Normally evaluates a condition without changing files.
riskReason: The expression is usually read-only; inspect surrounding commands for effects.

description: Runs Gradle tasks defined by a project or plugin.
impact: Tasks may execute code, download dependencies, and change project or system files.
riskReason: The build scripts and selected tasks determine the effects.

description: Runs a Maven Wrapper configured by the project and executes requested Maven goals.
impact: May download Maven, execute plugins, and create or remove project files.
riskReason: Wrapper configuration and Maven plugins can execute project code.

description: Applies patches from mailbox-formatted files as commits.
impact: Changes the working tree, index, and local commit history.
riskReason: Unreviewed patches can alter project files and history.

description: Applies a patch to files in a working tree or index.
impact: Changes project files or staged content.
riskReason: A patch can modify or remove code and configuration.

description: Creates patch files from commits for review or transfer.
impact: Creates files containing project changes and commit metadata.
riskReason: Patch files may disclose private code or author information.

description: Builds, tests, and manages Elixir projects and dependencies.
impact: May download packages, execute project code, and create build artifacts.
riskReason: Dependencies and project tasks determine what executes.

description: Manages Dart packages and dependencies.
impact: May download packages and change project dependency files.
riskReason: Third-party packages can introduce code and dependency changes.

description: Builds Haskell packages and manages dependencies and project configuration.
impact: May download source packages, execute build steps, and write artifacts.
riskReason: Build scripts and dependencies can run code.

description: Builds Haskell projects and manages compiler and package dependencies.
impact: May download compilers and packages and create build outputs.
riskReason: Project configuration and dependencies determine what code is built or executed.

description: Manages OCaml compiler and package environments.
impact: May install or remove packages and alter the selected environment.
riskReason: Packages and setup steps can affect the development environment.

description: Manages front-end packages using the legacy Bower package manager.
impact: May download packages and change project dependency files.
riskReason: Third-party package content and outdated dependencies can introduce risk.

description: Runs Git's general command-line interface; a subcommand is normally used to inspect or change a repository.
impact: With no subcommand it usually displays usage information; options and subcommands determine other effects.
riskReason: Git subcommands can read, modify, or publish repository data.

description: Displays Git help or version information without changing repository contents.
impact: Reads local program information and displays it.
riskReason: Normally read-only and informational.

description: Compares two files byte by byte and reports whether they differ.
impact: Reads the selected files and reports comparison results.
riskReason: Normally read-only, though file paths and output may expose sensitive information.

description: Opens Visual Studio Code or manages editor extensions and workspaces, depending on options.
impact: May open files, change extensions, or launch workspace tooling.
riskReason: Workspace tasks and extensions may execute project code.

description: Uses the project's Maven Wrapper to compile source code and run earlier lifecycle steps.
impact: May download Maven, execute plugins, and write build outputs.
riskReason: Wrapper configuration and plugins can execute project-defined code.

description: Uses the project's Maven Wrapper to compile and run its tests.
impact: May download Maven and execute build and test code.
riskReason: Tests and plugins can perform actions beyond assertions.

description: Uses the project's Maven Wrapper to run lifecycle checks through verification.
impact: May download Maven, execute plugins, and create build artifacts.
riskReason: Wrapper and plugin configuration can execute project code.

description: Uses the project's Maven Wrapper to compile and package the project.
impact: May download Maven, run plugins, and create a distributable artifact.
riskReason: Build plugins can execute project-defined operations.

description: Uses the project's Maven Wrapper to remove configured generated build output.
impact: Deletes files in project build directories.
riskReason: Custom lifecycle configuration may remove additional generated data.

description: Uses the project's Maven Wrapper to build and install the artifact in the local Maven repository.
impact: Creates build files and changes the local dependency cache.
riskReason: Build plugins execute project code and installed artifacts can affect later builds.

description: Uses the project's Maven Wrapper to publish a built artifact to a configured remote repository.
impact: May download Maven and upload project artifacts externally.
riskReason: Deployment publishes software and may expose unintended artifacts.

description: Uses the project's Maven Wrapper to display the resolved dependency tree.
impact: Reads project configuration and may contact repositories to resolve metadata.
riskReason: Normally informational, but wrapper and plugin configuration should be trusted.

description: Runs the Node.js package manager; the subcommand determines whether it inspects, changes, or publishes packages.
impact: May change dependencies, execute scripts, or communicate with a package registry.
riskReason: Review subcommands, project scripts, and configured package sources.

description: Runs the Python package installer; the subcommand determines whether it inspects or changes an environment.
impact: May download, install, or remove packages.
riskReason: Package code and configured sources can affect the environment.

description: Runs the Python 3 package installer; the subcommand determines the operation.
impact: May download, install, or remove packages from a Python environment.
riskReason: Third-party packages may execute code and change the selected environment.

description: Compares text files or other inputs and displays their differences.
impact: Reads the selected data and prints changed lines.
riskReason: Normally read-only, though output may expose private file contents.

description: Runs the Apache Maven build tool; the selected goal or lifecycle phase determines its effects.
impact: May execute project plugins, download dependencies, and change generated files.
riskReason: Project plugins and configuration can execute code with the user's permissions.

description: Runs the Docker command-line tool; subcommands inspect or change containers, images, and related resources.
impact: May start processes, modify container resources, or access configured host mounts and networks.
riskReason: Privileges, mounted host paths, and destructive subcommands can significantly affect the host.

description: Runs a command so it can continue after the calling terminal closes.
impact: The child process may continue using resources or changing data in the background.
riskReason: Long-running background work may be difficult to notice or stop.

description: Runs a command and reports how long it takes; some shells provide this as a built-in.
impact: The wrapped command executes with its normal effects.
riskReason: Review the command being measured because time itself does not make it safe.

description: Asks a shell to run one of its built-in commands rather than an external executable.
impact: The selected built-in may change shell state or run an operation.
riskReason: The effects depend on the built-in command that follows.

description: Runs a command in place of the current shell process or changes shell file descriptors.
impact: May replace the shell process or redirect its input and output.
riskReason: The command and redirections determine the resulting process and data flow.

description: In Windows batch files, invokes another batch file and returns to the caller afterward.
impact: Executes the called script, which may change files or system settings.
riskReason: The called script's contents and permissions determine its effects.

description: Runs a program in a new session, separate from the current terminal session.
impact: The launched process may continue independently and perform its normal actions.
riskReason: Detached processes may be less visible to the user.

description: Runs or adjusts a process with a selected disk input/output scheduling priority.
impact: Changes process scheduling behavior and may affect system responsiveness.
riskReason: Incorrect priorities can interfere with other system workloads.

description: Runs a program with configured buffering for standard input, output, or error streams.
impact: Changes when output is delivered; the wrapped command still executes normally.
riskReason: Review the wrapped command because stdbuf does not limit its effects.

description: Runs a command with a selected scheduling priority on Unix-like systems.
impact: Changes how the process competes for CPU time.
riskReason: The wrapped command retains its normal access and effects.

description: Runs a command for a limited duration and then may send it a signal.
impact: The command runs until completion or timeout and may be interrupted.
riskReason: A timeout does not prevent changes the command makes before it stops.

description: Starts a program or opens a document using the platform's associated application.
impact: May launch a process that reads or changes data.
riskReason: The launched program and arguments determine the actual effects.

description: Builds and runs a command using items read from input.
impact: May execute a command repeatedly on many paths or values.
riskReason: Input expansion can affect more files or targets than expected.

description: Runs or manages a Windows Subsystem for Linux distribution and its commands.
impact: The Linux process may access shared files and perform actions as the configured user.
riskReason: Commands can affect files available to both Windows and Linux environments.

description: Runs a command or looks up its location using shell command-resolution rules.
impact: The selected command executes with its normal effects.
riskReason: Inspect the resolved command and its arguments rather than treating this wrapper as harmless.

description: Runs a command while suppressing its output when it succeeds, commonly in automation.
impact: The wrapped command executes and can change files or system state.
riskReason: Suppressed output can make unexpected behavior less visible.

description: Runs a command with a selected group identity on supported Unix-like systems.
impact: Changes the group permissions available to the child command.
riskReason: Group access may allow changes to shared or protected resources.

description: Runs a program with terminal-like output buffering, often for automation.
impact: The wrapped program executes with its normal effects.
riskReason: Review the program being launched; unbuffer only changes output handling.

description: Reads and executes a script in the current shell process, changing that shell's environment.
impact: The script can modify files, variables, and shell settings or launch other programs.
riskReason: Sourced scripts run with the current user's permissions and may affect the calling shell.

description: Opens a file or item using its default associated application.
impact: May launch a program or open content that triggers additional behavior.
riskReason: The associated application and selected file determine subsequent effects.

description: Loads and invokes supported functions from Windows DLL files.
impact: Can load system or third-party code into a process.
riskReason: The DLL and requested function determine behavior and may change system state.

description: Registers or unregisters COM components on Windows.
impact: Changes system registration information and loads component code.
riskReason: Registration can affect how applications load components; review the target file.
